description: Exact scoped localization layout changes; reverse these without changing the frozen historical CSS baseline.

changes.reason: Long disclosure summaries wrap as a group and preserve the arrow slot.
changes.before: .setting-disclosure { width: 100%; min-height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #4a4c52; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
changes.after:
/* 摘要放不下时整组换行；右侧箭头有独立位置，不被英文长标签挤出侧栏。 */
.setting-disclosure { position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 34px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px 8px; padding: 7px 24px 7px 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: #4a4c52; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }

changes.reason: Keep the summary readable when its flex row wraps.
changes.before: .setting-disclosure__summary { min-width: 0; margin-left: auto; overflow: hidden; color: #85878d; font-size: 11px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
changes.after: .setting-disclosure__summary { min-width: 0; flex: 0 0 auto; margin-left: auto; color: #85878d; font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }

changes.reason: Reserve a stable arrow slot independent of translated label width.
changes.before: .setting-disclosure__chevron { width: 16px; color: #9b9da2; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; text-align: right; transition: transform .12s ease; }
changes.after: .setting-disclosure__chevron { position: absolute; right: 0; top: calc(50% - 9px); width: 16px; color: #9b9da2; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; text-align: right; transition: transform .12s ease; }

changes.reason: Move an option group to the next line when the label and group do not fit.
changes.before: .disclosure-setting-row { min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
changes.after: .disclosure-setting-row { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px 10px; }

changes.reason: Size time option buttons by their actual localized labels instead of Chinese pixel widths.
Share an intrinsic label column and wrap full timestamps rather than overlap or truncate them.
Wrap long Japanese theme names within their card.
changes.before: .settings-theme-choice strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
changes.after:
/* 日文主题名较长：允许在卡片内换行，不省略掉用户需要辨认的名称。 */
.settings-theme-choice strong { min-width: 0; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

changes.reason: Keep Markdown fully inside the format button at 320px.
changes.before: .export-format__buttons { height: 31px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #e5e5e8; border-radius: 8px; background: #f7f7f8; }
changes.after:
/* Markdown 比其他格式名长；保留每个标签的固有宽度，再分配剩余空间。 */
.export-format__buttons { height: 31px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(max-content, 1fr)); gap: 3px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #e5e5e8; border-radius: 8px; background: #f7f7f8; }

changes.reason: Keep Orientation and Japanese font-size labels separate from complete segmented buttons.
changes.before:
.export-choice-row { min-height: 33px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #777980; font-size: 11px; }
.export-mini-segment { min-width: 0; height: 27px; display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; grid-auto-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--surface-subtle); }
